# langsmith_workspace_role (Resource)

Manages a custom LangSmith workspace role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Role description.
- `display_name` (String) Role display name.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions assigned to this role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `name` (String) Generated role name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID for this custom role.
